sections.name: File setup, SecurityModule
sections.title: Rate limit settings
sections.what: Defines the two request limits and applies the throttle guard to all routes.
sections.why: Likely reason: protects the API from floods and abuse. The values are written in the comments.
sections.watch_out: The client address used for counting depends on proxy settings that are not in this file.

summary: Adds a global request limit that rejects clients who send too many requests too quickly.
purpose: Protects the API from floods and abuse.
why: The header says rate limiting and hardening. The limit values are stated in the comments.
how: 1) Register two limits: 100 requests per minute and 10000 requests per hour. 2) Attach the throttle guard to every route through the global guard slot.
outputs: Either the request goes through, or the client receives a too-many-requests rejection.
risks: Limits are usually counted per client address, so many users behind one shared address, such as a proxy or office network, share one limit. The hourly limit of 10000 is high. Login lockout is a separate setting and is not governed by this file.
debug: If users see too-many-requests errors, check the limit values and how the client address appears behind any proxy.
